---

Umar Jaise Guzar Gayi Yakdam.

1
Jab Moafi Hayat Ke Samjha.
Howas-e-Maal-o-Zaar Gayi Yakdam.
Raat Darya Ka Band Tootne Se.
Kitni Makhlooq Mar Gayi Yakdam.
Gardish-e-Waqt Mere Daman Mein.
Ranj-o-Aalaam Dhar Gayi Yakdam.

2
Aas Deedar Ki Jo Toot Gayi.
Phir Hamari Nazar Gayi Yakdam.
Zindagi Ne Hazaar Zakhm Diye.
Moat Har Zakhm Bhar Gayi Yakdam.
Baat Pori Hi Karne Wala Tha.
Rooh Parwaaz Kar Gayi Yakdam.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/kitne-zeene-utar-gayi-yakdam-tajpoints-e55b12f0c01a75487276.md')
old = p.read_text()
_, meta, body = old.split('---', 2)
roman = [line.rstrip('.') for line in body.strip().splitlines()]
roman = [line[:1].upper() + line[1:].lower() for line in roman]
meta = meta.replace('title: \"Kitne Zeene Utar Gayi Yakdam\"', 'title: \"کتنے زینے اتر گئی یکدم\"\\nalternateTitle: \"Kitne Zeene Utar Gayi Yakdam\"').replace('direction: \"ltr\"', 'direction: \"rtl\"').replace('tags: [\"noUrdu\"]\\n', '')
source = \"\"\"عمر جیسے گزر گئی یکدم

۱
جب معافی حیات کے سمجھا
ہوسِ مال و زر گئی یکدم
رات دریا کا بند ٹوٹنے سے
کتنی مخلوق مر گئی یکدم
گردشِ وقت میرے دامن میں
رنج و آلام دھر گئی یکدم

۲
آس دیدار کی جو ٹوٹ گئی
پھر ہماری نظر گئی یکدم
زندگی نے ہزار زخم دیے
موت ہر زخم بھر گئی یکدم
بات پوری ہی کرنے والا تھا
روح پرواز کر گئی یکدم\"\"\"
assert len(roman) == len(source.splitlines())
for r, s in zip(roman, source.splitlines()):
    assert bool(r) == bool(s)
    if r.isdigit():
        assert int(r) == int(s)
p.write_text('---' + meta + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + '\\n'.join('  ' + line if line else '' for line in roman) + '\\n---\\n\\n' + source + '\\n')
PY
git diff --check -- src/data/lyrics/kitne-zeene-utar-gayi-yakdam-tajpoints-e55b12f0c01a75487276.md"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 13 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, with sentence case and verse-end periods removed. Verified that the opening verse and both six-verse stanzas align line by line. Updated the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, retained the Roman alternate title, and removed `noUrdu`.

The Roman reading `Moafi` is ambiguous in context. I rendered it as `معافی` to stay close to the supplied pronunciation.
